doc: Ch7 'The Tidecup' (M3-C07-02; docs/kb/story/beats/act1_ch07.md B01-B10; docs/kb/tech/chapter_flow.md 'Ch7'). Two greybox zones, played by ZoneStory: ch07/tamsule (the port) and ch07/tamsule_bell_galleries (the story's stand-in for the Bell's galleries, pool and moorings; the arena itself, ch07/tamsule_bell, is env-art's and the Reefball agent's). ENTRY: Ch6 (not built) will hand off to ch07/tamsule at RiverMouth; until then the zone is reached from its own locations.json row. The port: B01 on arrival (the chapter becomes 7, the chapter autosave), the B02 barks, B03 when Rhen walks on to the market boats (Tavi; Pio's side-band), then the gantry foot to the Bell. The Bell: B04 on arrival (the galleries; then Rhen on the pool steps and a checkpoint autosave, so a reload starts at the rim), B05 at the rim (the naming), which ends on <<event start_reefball tidecup_opening>>. THE REEFBALL SEAM is the beat 'reefball_match' in ch07/tamsule_bell_galleries, run by the naming beat's if_event step: it hands off to the match scene, TidecupMatch (game/levels/ch07/tidecup_match/, data game/data/flow/ch07_tidecup.json; M3-C07-1206), which plays the Reefball engine's story match through the HUD and, at its end, sets ch07_tidecup_played always, ch07_tidecup_won on a win only (a reward, never read by the story), gives the win reward, and returns to ch07/tamsule_bell_galleries at CatchPool, where the arrival row plays B07 identically for both results. B07 sets ch07_tavi_withdrew; then the moorings side scene (B09, Tavi at his boat; it takes Pio's band, and the Pemakar leaf-boat if Rhen kept it) and the way back to the port. The port's barks swap to their after-match variants (B08). B10 at the harbour. EXIT: B10 hands off to Ch8's ch08/corrow at Mole (M3-C08-02). Ch7 has no foes. Party: Rhen, Asha and Toma, with Ysolde in reserve (Liss and Kerrid have no battle rows yet; they are stage actors).
